dependencies.name: 420 Identity
dependencies.reason: Participant profile/controller/activity and sale eligibilityPolicyHash credential-type checks are enforced before a Pay-backed contribution is accepted.

dependencies.name: 420 Pay
dependencies.reason: Contribution evidence is a globally one-use PaymentRegistry paymentId in SETTLED state with exact payer, merchant, settlement asset, amount and nonzero receipt binding; refund recording requires canonical Pay refund state.

dependencies.name: 420 Arbitration
dependencies.reason: Launchpad verifies canonical case claimant/respondent/domain/component/sale origin and publishes finalized ruling/remedy evidence without acquiring ruling, cancellation or refund-execution authority.

dependencies.name: 420Reputation
dependencies.reason: Replay-protected CROWDFUNDING contribution and reward-delivery evidence events preserve canonical evidence references for the replaceable Reputation service without creating universal reputation authority.

dependencies.name: 420 Notifications
dependencies.reason: Deterministic replay-protected Launchpad contribution/refund/delivery/dispute/ruling events plus canonical sale lifecycle events provide the registered dApp notification source boundary; Notifications remains non-authoritative.
